name: ContactPoint
description: Base StructureDefinition for ContactPoint Type: Details for all kinds of technology mediated contact points for a person or organization, including telephone, email, etc.

system.short: phone | fax | email | pager | url | sms | other

use.short: home | work | temp | old | mobile - purpose of this contact point
use.isModifierReason: This is labeled as "Is Modifier" because applications should not mistake a temporary or old contact etc.for a current/permanent one

rank.short: Specify preferred order of use (1 = highest)

period.short: Time period when the contact point was/is in use
